title: Injectivity of configuration records
statement: Fix a natural number $s$ and two configurations $c,d$ on the same finite Boolean input, together with tags $\tau,\tau'$. Suppose the head positions of both configurations lie within distance $s$ of the origin on every work tape, and both configurations have blank cells at every integer position whose absolute value exceeds $s$. Their records with tags $\tau$ and $\tau'$ are equal if and only if their states, input-head positions, work-tape contents, and work-tape head positions agree, and their tags agree.
hypotheses_covered: $c,d$ are configurations on the same finite Boolean input
for each tape, every head position of $c$ has absolute value at most $s$
for each tape, every cell of $c$ outside $[-s,s]$ is blank
for each tape, every head position of $d$ has absolute value at most $s$
for each tape, every cell of $d$ outside $[-s,s]$ is blank
